description: This Dart source file defines a mock API service for a bookstore frontend. It includes fake data generation for books, methods to list, retrieve, and search books, and categories, intended for testing and development purposes.

classes.name: MockBookApi
classes.description: A stubbed API service for books that simulates backend calls for listing, retrieving, and searching books with mock data.

methods.name: listBooks
methods.description: Returns a list of books, limited by the provided parameter, after a brief delay.

methods.name: getBook
methods.description: Retrieves a book by its ID, or null if not found, after a brief delay.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for books matching the query in title or author, case-insensitive, after a brief delay.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Returns a list of book categories, simulating an API call delay.
